id.description: Stable identity, generated once and never reused. Nothing in the catalog references an item by path.

date.description: First release date, at whatever precision the source supports: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Don't pad in fabricated precision.

description.description: Prose context. Original synthesis only, never pasted or lightly reworded source text.

image.description: URL of the item's own image, from an authoritative source (or a retailer/marketplace photo, as a documented fallback when no authoritative source exists).

tags.description: Ids referencing tag entities under tags/, for cross-cutting groupings (e.g. franchise) that directory position doesn't already express.

attributes.description: Category-specific structured data, validated against the nearest schema.json in this item's own governing directory.

variants.description: Physically distinct variants of this item (e.g. a print/colorway difference), each its own sub-entity with its own required id and name; other fields are optional and may be treated as inherited from this item when omitted. A variant cannot itself have variants — nesting is capped at one level.
